description: submission.rs handle_submission_set, onSuccessUpdateEmail branch: update_object::<Email> result is matched as Ok(_) => insert Value::Null, same bug as Identity/set. RFC 8620 §5.3 requires server-modified fields to be echoed. The implicit Email/set response produced by onSuccessUpdateEmail will always report null for updated emails even when the backend returns Some(obj). This is part of the same incomplete fix that left Identity/set broken.
title: submission.rs onSuccessUpdateEmail update discards Ok(Some(obj)) echo
